title: Guava Farming Practices and Harvesting
reason: The video describes the detailed process of guava cultivation, from planting to harvesting, providing a comprehensive understanding of the organic farming technique.

tasks.task: Describe the initial planting and care of guava plants.

subtasks.text: Observe the selection and careful planting of healthy guava sprouts.
Notice the precision planting with recommended distances between guava trees.

tasks.task: Explain the irrigation and maintenance practices for mature guava trees.

subtasks.text: Watch the installation of a drip irrigation system to conserve water.
Note the importance of filtration in the irrigation water.
Inspect the trimming of guava trees to promote healthy growth and fruit development.

tasks.task: Highlight the stages leading up to and including fruit harvest.

subtasks.text: Notice the process of harvest and careful handling of guavas.
